description:
Story 2 of fz-kdt.13 Strategy v3 (cold-reviewed; read the parent's Strategy
section first -- it is binding). ENGINE ONLY: no semantic.rs changes (that is
fz-kdt.13.2).

Refine the ledger's publisher identity from J to (J, DerivationId) across:
- DependencyIndex reads/subscribers/outputs (deps.rs)
- FactTable publishers/dirty_publishers/unfinal_publishers (facts.rs)
- Scheduler unfinal_reads (scheduler.rs)

Agenda and the rebased set stay per-Job. A shift-classified cause dirties
EVERY derivation of the woken job (rebase selects join-vs-replace downstream
and must veto all scoping). complete() accepts per-derivation
(reads, outputs, changed); the default -- one derivation per job -- must be
byte-for-byte today's behavior (all existing counts, streams, and pins
unchanged). Blocked (waiting) completions: derivations the run concluded
before blocking are clean; unreached ones stay dirty.

is_locally_settled, clear_unfinal_publishers, and the drain arbiter's
soundness argument hold VERBATIM at derivation granularity (they provably
break under naive per-output dirty bits -- see the cold review's A8 in the
parent ticket history). Restate their comments in derivation terms.

## Red-first engine tests (before any semantic use exists)
- A publisher with two derivations: moving derivation 1's input leaves
  derivation 2's fact settled and evaluates nobody.
- Same chain with a Settled waiter on derivation 2's fact: must NOT fire
  early, must fire when derivation 2's own input moves.
- Premature-settled canaries: the two wrong-compile sites (frontier
  retirement; None-behind-the-settled-gate as empty type) get engine-level
  guards where representable.
- Existing scheduler tests (readiness_only_movement_evaluates_nobody, the
  kdt.44 suite) green unchanged.

## Checks
- Default single-derivation path: all three target fixtures produce
  byte-identical causal streams vs base (same evals, same movements).
- Zero-uncaused, cross-process multisets, byte-identical BackendProgram,
  job-order determinism: green unweakened.
- The telemetry stream may need derivation identity on applied events --
  ONLY if required for the causal replay to keep attributing; prefer no
  stream change in this story (single-derivation default emits identically).
title: Publisher identity becomes (Job, DerivationId) in the one ledger
